origin.note: Local ENU projection origin for the playable area. All world coordinates in the game are meters east/north of this point.

landmarks.name: 1916 Seddon Rd
landmarks.description: Primary mission objective. Residential address in the Ginter Park / Rosedale area of Richmond's Northside.

landmarks.name: Belle Isle
landmarks.description: 54-acre island in the James River, part of the James River Park System, downtown Richmond.

landmarks.name: CSX A-Line (Atlantic Coast Line) Bridge
landmarks.description: 1919 concrete arch railroad bridge built jointly by the Atlantic Coast Line and RF&P railroads, carrying CSX's A-Line over the James River.

landmarks.name: Hollywood Rapids
landmarks.description: Class III-IV whitewater rapid on the James, named for Hollywood Cemetery on the bluff above, near Belle Isle.

landmarks.name: Pipeline Rapids
landmarks.description: Class IV rapid along the Pipeline Walkway near Brown's Island in downtown Richmond.

landmarks.name: Cooper's Island
landmarks.description: Approximate placement. Not found as an official, precisely-mapped feature; the closest match is a 'Coopers' rapid/hole labeled on the official James River Park System map between Pony Pasture and the CSX bridge. Adjust lat/lon here if you have a more exact location (e.g. from Google Earth).
